name: Evolve
description: Pod-wide adaptation for OpenClaw bot networks — measures, analyzes, and proposes behavioral improvements

botId.description: Unique identifier for this bot in the network (e.g. 'mybot')

role.description: Role in the network. 'primary' consolidates and alerts, 'member' measures and reports.

networkId.description: Network identifier — all bots in the same network share this value

sharedDir.description: Path to shared directory readable/writable by all bots (default: /Users/Shared/evolve)

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the deploy checkout (the read-only repo daemons load from), used to locate packages/analyzer scripts. Injected by deploy from platform_profile.deploy_checkout_default — /Users/Shared/evolve-repo on macOS, /var/lib/evolve/repo on Linux. When absent (bot not yet redeployed), the plugin falls back to the legacy dirname(sharedDir)/evolve-repo derivation.

classifierModel.description: Model to use for tier classification (default: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5)

tierClassification.description: Granularity of tier classification. Start with 'session'. (default: session)

dashboardEnabled.description: Whether to serve the dashboard HTTP route (default: true for primary, false for others)

summarizerMinTurns.description: Minimum turns before SessionSummarizer runs LLM outcome extraction. Sessions with fewer turns skip the summarizer. (default: 2)

classifierKeywordConfidenceFloor.description: Minimum keyword-classifier confidence below which LLMTierClassifier escalates to the LLM tier model. (default: 0.80)

costLedgerEnabled.description: Whether TurnObserver writes per-turn cost ledger entries. (default: true)

prefixHashLedgerEnabled.description: Context-observability Phase 0: emit a per-turn hash of the appendSystemContext string (plus per-block hashes) to {sharedDir}/{botId}/turns/prefix-hashes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl, so prefix stability can be joined against cache_read_input_tokens. Dark by default; only the exact boolean true enables. (default: false)

execFailureAbsorb.description: Arms the exec-failure channel-hygiene absorber (design-exec-failure-hygiene-2026-08-31 A1). false = OBSERVE-ONLY: raw '⚠️ 🛠️ Exec failed …' trailer matches on outbound channel messages are ledgered to {sharedDir}/{botId}/exec-failures/ but delivered unchanged. true = matched trailer lines are stripped (a payload that is nothing but trailer is cancelled). Only the exact boolean true arms absorption; any non-boolean value stays observe-only and logs a warning. Model-visible tool results are never touched. (default: false)

layer2Enforce.description: Arms the below-LLM Layer-2 per-role tool-call enforcement gate. false = OBSERVE-ONLY: the gate resolves the speaker's role per tool call and records every would-block, but always allows the call. true = the gate BLOCKS tool calls the speaker's role does not grant. Only the exact boolean true arms enforcement; any non-boolean value stays observe-only and logs a warning. (default: false)

tier.description: Per-bot Evolve integration tier. Controls intrusive features like conduct injection, defer tool, and recommendation injection. (default: full)
